name: wcstack-stamp-rally
description: Seam app: a town-walk stamp rally opened on the walker's own phone — the screen and sensor elements: a device check that keeps five answers apart, saved passwords, the eye dropper and the contact picker, a compass, steps and a shake to stamp, fullscreen held in landscape, a guide video in a small window across pages, the share sheet, and the city's portal showing it in an iframe.
